entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.>> We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, [what] work thou didst in their days, in the times of old. {Maschil: or, of instruction}

entries.title: Psalms 44:2
segments: [How] thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; [how] thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

entries.title: Psalms 44:3
segments: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 44:5
segments: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

words.text: Through thee will we push down

entries.title: Psalms 44:6
segments: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

entries.title: Psalms 44:7
segments: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

words.text: , and hast put them to shame

entries.title: Psalms 44:8
segments: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 44:9
segments: ¶But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

entries.title: Psalms 44:10
segments: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: Thou hast given us like sheep [appointed] for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen. {like...: Heb. as sheep of meat}

entries.title: Psalms 44:12
segments: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase [thy wealth] by their price. {for...: Heb. without riches}

entries.title: Psalms 44:13
segments: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

words.text: to them that are round about

entries.title: Psalms 44:14
segments: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

entries.title: Psalms 44:15
segments: My confusion [is] continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: ¶All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

words.text: upon us; yet have we not forgotten
thee, neither have we dealt falsely

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way; {steps: or, goings}

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

words.text: us with the shadow of death

entries.title: Psalms 44:20
segments: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

entries.title: Psalms 44:21
segments: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

words.text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed

entries.title: Psalms 44:23
segments: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 44:24
segments: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 44:26
segments: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake. {for our...: Heb. a help for us}

words.text: ' sake. {for our...: Heb. a help for us}
